meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: Claude 会把目录、链接、笔记或刚才对话里的工作流程整理成一份可复用的技能说明文件，存到项目的 .claude/skills 文件夹；若已有同名技能，则就地更新它。
howto.when: 当你说出“/learn”等指令，或要求“把来源做成技能”“改进现有技能”时触发。

say.note: 会读取页面内容并生成技能文件

say.text: /learn 把我们刚才做的流程整理成技能
say.note: 会从对话里提炼步骤和坑
会就地改进现有技能，不乱覆盖

howto.what_en: Claude turns a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the recent conversation into a reusable skill file saved under .claude/skills; if a same-named skill already exists, it updates it in place.
howto.when_en: Triggers on “/learn” and similar commands, or when asked to turn a source into a skill or improve/update an existing skill.

say_en.text: /learn this URL, turn it into a skill
say_en.note: Reads the page and writes a skill file

say_en.text: /learn what we just did as a skill
say_en.note: Distills steps and gotchas from chat
Refines the existing skill in place
